overview: The committee set its 2023 meeting schedule and Energy Festival date, received updates on city planning staff and waste contract procurement, and reviewed Arlington's volunteer heat pump coaching model.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the December 5th meeting.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Alicia Hunt announced several planning department vacancies and the creation of a new grant-funded climate zoning and policy position.

items.title: Waste Initiatives Status
items.summary: Staff reported on the drafting of a request for proposals for a new 7-to-10-year waste contract and Medford’s participation in a DEP peer group for municipal waste procurement.

items.title: Energy Festival 2023 Date
items.summary: Approved October 14, 2023, as the date for the annual Harvest Your Energy Festival.

items.title: 2023 Committee Meeting Calendar
items.summary: Approved the 2023 meeting schedule, maintaining a first-Monday monthly frequency with adjustments for holidays and election eve.

items.title: Fossil Fuel Ban Pilot Program
items.summary: Discussed whether to join the state's 10-community pilot program banning fossil fuels in new buildings, with members ultimately favoring the new stretch code over a total ban to avoid discouraging development.

items.title: Legislative and Ordinance Updates
items.summary: Noted a lack of updates regarding tree and leaf blower ordinances and briefly reviewed a new state law requiring a four-foot passing distance for vulnerable road users.

items.title: Electrify Arlington Presentation
items.summary: Mark Breslow detailed Arlington's volunteer 'heat pump coach' program, which provides residents with technical consultations and quote reviews for residential electrification.

items.title: Committee Operational Bandwidth and Goals
items.summary: Discussed the committee's independent status and capacity for legislative advocacy, concluding with a proposal to draft a formal 2023 goal list for the Mayor.
